question: Do extreme winners enter through a repeatable stock-level transition in which market-relative strength improves into the entry signal while volatility, trading range, and downside-session traded-amount share contracted earlier?
mechanism: Latent demand strengthens relative to the market while supply pressure and price variability contract, followed by relative-strength release into the completed-close entry signal.
prediction: Extreme-winner probability is positively associated with late relative-strength improvement and with prior volatility, range, and downside-amount contraction; the RS component and at least one supply/compression component must survive fixed V1-entry, market, breadth, beta, liquidity, temporal, concentration, and strategy-path falsification.

sample.conditioning: Actual frozen V1 entry cycles only; no non-entry controls and no universe substitution.
sample.missingness: No imputation. A primary 20-session window requires 21 contiguous hard-valid rows and 20 exact causal coordinate steps. Unknown lineage fails closed.

timestamp_semantics.T_minus_1: Completed entry-signal close, available at 15:00 Asia/Shanghai and applicable only to the later first-valid entry execution.
timestamp_semantics.other_anchors: T-k is k-1 exchange sessions before the entry-signal close for k in 60,40,20,10,5,3,1.

feature_definitions.relative_strength20: Sum of the stock's exact action-safe 20 daily log returns minus the 399102 20-session log return.
feature_definitions.realized_vol20: Sample standard deviation of the 20 exact stock daily log returns times sqrt(252).
feature_definitions.range_width20: (maximum action-coordinate high minus minimum action-coordinate low) over the latest action-coordinate close in the 20-bar window.
feature_definitions.downside_amount_share20: Traded amount on negative stock-return sessions divided by total traded amount over the 20-bar window; this is not classified order flow.
feature_definitions.higher_low10: Log ratio of the latest 10-bar minimum low to the prior 10-bar minimum low.
feature_definitions.lower_high10: Log ratio of the latest 10-bar maximum high to the prior 10-bar maximum high.
feature_definitions.distance_to_prior_high20: Log of anchor close divided by maximum high over the prior 20 bars, excluding the anchor bar.
feature_definitions.amount_ratio5_to_prior15: Mean traded amount over the last five bars divided by mean traded amount over the prior 15 bars.

fixed_controls.estimator: Pearson correlation of predictor and binary extreme-winner residuals after separate least-squares projections; predictor and continuous controls are percentile ranked.

primary_gates.component_raw: rho >= 0.10, BH q <= 0.10 across exactly four primaries, positive within-year rank rho, positive in >=7/8 LOYO estimates, and positive fixed T-3 neighbor with >=6/8 LOYO signs.
primary_gates.component_controlled: partial-rank rho >= 0.10 with positive sign in >=7/8 controlled LOYO estimates.
primary_gates.component_falsification: Positive after removing global Top-4 P&L cycles, after holding-duration/exit-reason controls, after industry fixed effects, and in >=80% leave-one-extreme-security-out and leave-one-industry-out estimates.
primary_gates.family_support: RS improvement and at least one volatility/range/downside-amount contraction component pass all gates.

decision.REFINE: at least one component passes but the full mechanism does not
decision.PIVOT: a raw component passes but controlled/falsification gates fail

falsification: eight fixed LOYO omissions and within-entry-year ranks
global Top-4 realized-PnL removal as the fixed top-1% sensitivity
fixed market return, market volatility, breadth, stock beta, and traded-amount liquidity controls
post-outcome holding-duration and exit-reason sensitivity, explicitly not a causal control
PIT timestamps, action-coordinate continuity, first-applicable entry ordering, and zero post-entry price use
forbidden: breadth historical redesign, threshold, overlay, or interaction
feature or horizon replacement after results
large feature screen or feature-combination search
post-entry or post-exit price use in trajectory construction
conversion of group differences into entry filters
untouched OOS, PIT-A, causal order-flow, or deployability claim
